title: [Dev] Timestamps are showing as HH:mm PM/AM 12 hour format instead of 24 hour format in english
body:
In 3.3 its 24-hours format, so probably some of the latest commits caused this.

But strings are not consistent in format so some places it show am/pm and some 24h format in English.
